feed.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Does the town rebuild Turkey Hill, renovate it, or neither -- and with what MSBA help?

entry.title: Now following: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate
entry.summary: Does the town rebuild Turkey Hill, renovate it, or neither -- and with what MSBA help?

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Superintendent's draft FY27 evaluation goals: ELA growth, professional culture, Turkey Hill MSBA SOI, and financial leadership

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: Formal review/vote on school committee goals for the year is deferred to next week; goals discussed include continuing the Turkey Hill MSBA process, implementing the primary school parking lot/playground study, and pursuing financial stability including using audit findings.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: FY24/FY25 capital plan — various small remaining balances. Numerous FY24-FY25 capital projects are complete with small remaining balances, including public safety radio, Turkey Hill fire system, security upgrades, court resurfacing, safety film, police vehicles, library cameras, and the Northfield Culvert/Kelly's Pond project still in design.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-08-03
entry.summary: Turkey Hill/MSBA timeline for repair-vs-replace decision and its effect on future community center options; adjournment

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Committee agreed it needs an MSBA primer/presentation for a future meeting and to begin familiarizing itself and the public with the MSBA process for Turkey Hill.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: MSBA accelerated repair program timeline and its bearing on TCP/Turkey Hill decisions

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Select Board, 2026-07-14
entry.summary: Turkey Hill/MSBA process, town buildings overview, public engagement and communication goals

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Planning Board, 2026-06-22
entry.summary: Committee reports: municipal building design committee update, extended discussion of Turkey Hill School's condition, ADA compliance costs, and MSBA funding constraints

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-06-15
entry.summary: Discussion of deferred maintenance, capital plan limitations, and long-term (50-year) planning including Turkey Hill's condition

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-06-01
entry.summary: Turkey Hill MSBA process and possible coordination with school committee on TC Pasquale's site

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Finance Committee, 2026-05-28
entry.summary: Turkey Hill rebuild/rehab. The school committee is expected to bring forward a plan for Turkey Hill that will involve a major rebuild or rehabilitation; the town is currently well positioned financially to handle it.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-04-27
entry.summary: Turkey Hill Elementary and the MSBA process timeline, plus a free building-assessment/PPP study of town buildings

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Green Community Task Force, 2026-04-27
entry.summary: Building design committee's direction is to keep and renovate Turkey Hill rather than replace it, aiming for at least 10 more years of use, and to pursue MSBA funding for the upgrade.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-04-15
entry.summary: Town meeting warrant articles, override placement, and capital plan items (Turkey Hill, primary school)

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-04-01
entry.summary: Wait to begin discussing the Turkey Hill MSBA application until the next (newly seated) committee member joins, to allow a summer runway.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-02-04
entry.summary: Legislative earmark for passenger vans. Superintendent sought permission to ask Rep. Scarsdale to redirect an existing $195,000 transportation earmark toward ADA-accessible bathroom renovations at Turkey Hill instead of buying passenger vans, citing ongoing driver/insurance/maintenance costs the district can't absorb.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-01-21
entry.summary: Old business: Turkey Hill Elementary capital planning directive

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Select Board, 2026-01-13
entry.summary: Capital planning requests. Capital planning discussed track and turf field engineering (targeting summer 2027 construction if approved at town meeting), plus primary school playground/driveway design, Turkey Hill intercom/security cameras, safety film, and a maintenance garage heating project.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-01-12
entry.summary: Debt service, exempt vs. non-exempt borrowing, capacity, and Turkey Hill/MSBA timing

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2026-01-07
entry.summary: Tony will draft a proposed framework/cost threshold for choosing between rebuilding Turkey Hill and building new under MSBA, to bring back for a vote.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Green Community Task Force, 2025-12-15
entry.summary: FY26 annual green-communities energy report presentation, including Turkey Hill's high energy use and MSBA timing

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Master Plan Steering Committee, 2025-12-10
entry.summary: Consolidate the Turkey Hill renovation and school-accessibility recommendations into one line about evaluating renovations to meet accessibility standards, removing the duplicate.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2025-12-03
entry.summary: The district will pursue a Massachusetts School Building Authority statement of intent for Turkey Hill targeting an April 2027 (not April 2026) submission.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Select Board, 2025-12-02
entry.summary: Committee reports: Board of Assessors and School Committee (FY27 budget scenarios, special education reserve fund, substitute pay, capital plan, Turkey Hill/MSBA, transportation)

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2025-11-19
entry.summary: Committee will wait for more information from the superintendent before deciding whether to submit an MSBA statement of interest for Turkey Hill this cycle.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Capital Planning Committee, 2025-11-19
entry.summary: The Turkey Hill track and field project will not be part of this capital planning cycle; it is expected to come forward as a separate article at spring town meeting.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2025-11-05
entry.summary: Agreed on a staged, multi-meeting approach to the Turkey Hill decision: first set the end-goal/needs for the building, then debate rehab vs. rebuild, then address funding options.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Capital Planning Committee, 2025-10-29
entry.summary: Turkey Hill window replacement design/architectural plan, FY30. Original single-pane windows need a full architectural replacement plan; may later qualify for MSBA accelerated repair funding if Turkey Hill remains a school 25-30 years.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2025-10-20
entry.summary: Committee leaning toward combining Turkey Hill renovation, a revised central office, the middle/high school track and field, and the primary school playground/entryway into one combined 'Lunenburg schools' project.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: rebuild or renovate: School Committee, 2025-10-15
entry.summary: School committee draft goals: Turkey Hill direction, capital plan, Kids Kingdom, playgrounds, budget rubric/audit
